title: Santaguida 1995: centroid distance of psoas major at L3-L4 (M, supine)

imaging.modality: MRI Philips Gyroscan 1.5 T, spin echo TR 500 TE 20
imaging.plane: transverse slices 10 mm apart T12-mid sacrum; values given at disc levels

quantity.name: centroid_distance
quantity.definition: distance from the vertebral-body (or disc) centroid to the muscle area centroid in the image plane; AP signed (+ anterior, - posterior), ML unsigned lateral distance. NOT a true moment arm

source.sample: 15 males (MRI) + 7 male embalmed cadavers; MRI: young healthy men (same demographics as McGill 1993: 25.3 y, 176.1 cm, 81.5 kg; very likely the same subjects); cadavers for architecture

how_to_simulate: At the L3-L4 disc, take the PCSA-weighted centroid of the right psoas paths in the transverse plane.
Report X (lateral) and Y (AP, + anterior) from the disc centre; centroid distance, not moment arm.
protocol.notes: Authors call these X/Y moment arms (disc centroid to muscle centroid). No effect of lordosis (flexed/neutral/extended, n=5 subset) was found (values not tabulated).

extraction.check_notes: Verified on rendered page 343; the L5/S1 X range upper bound partly illegible in text layer (47.7-66.39).
